env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m

cp ../want.txt $WORK/want.txt

logos run .
cmp stdout $WORK/want.txt

mkdir $WORK/orig
cp main.lgo $WORK/orig/main.lgo
cp wire/wire.lgo $WORK/orig/wire.lgo

logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
exists out/wire/wire.go

! grep '"comptime"' out/main.go
! grep '"comptime"' out/wire/wire.go
! grep '_logos_ctpkg' out/main.go
! grep '_logos_ctimp' out/main.go
! grep '_logos_tparam' out/main.go
! grep '_logos_ctcomptime' out/main.go
grep 'Total_logosct' out/main.go
! grep 'logosct' out/wire/wire.go
grep 'Weights_logosct2' out/main.go
! grep 'Weights_logosct4' out/main.go

cd out
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/want.txt
# SPEC 0.3: ejected output builds with upstream go1.27.2 from $UPROOT1272.
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...
go vet ./...
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .
cd ..

cmp main.lgo $WORK/orig/main.lgo
cmp wire/wire.lgo $WORK/orig/wire.lgo
-- want.txt --

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/ejectcross

go 1.27

-- m/wire/wire.lgo --
package wire

import (
	"comptime"
	"fmt"
	"strconv"
)

type Row struct {
	Name  string
	Count int
	Ok    bool
}

var Calls int

func Step(in string) (int, error) {
	Calls++
	if Calls == 4 {
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("stopped at step %d", Calls)
	}
	return strconv.Atoi(in)
}

func Total[T any](in string) (int, error) {
	sum := 0
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[T]() {
		n := Step(in)?
		sum += n
		fmt.Println($"{f.Name}={sum}")
	}
	return sum, nil
}

func Weights[T any]() int {
	s := 0
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[T]() {
		s += []int{1, 2, 3}.map(x => x + f.Index).sum()
	}
	return s
}

func Grid[T any](in string) (int, error) {
	sum := 0
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[T]() {
		const for _, g := range comptime.Fields[T]() {
			n := Step(in)?
			sum += n
			fmt.Println($"{f.Name}.{g.Name}={sum}")
		}
	}
	return sum, nil
}

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/ejectcross/wire"
)

type Local struct {
	A int
	B int
}

func main() {
	wire.Calls = 0
	fmt.Println(wire.Total[Local]("3"))
	wire.Calls = 2
	fmt.Println(wire.Total[wire.Row]("3"))
	fmt.Println(wire.Weights[Local]())
	fmt.Println(wire.Grid[Local]("1"))
	fmt.Println(wire.Weights[Local]())
}
